image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a tiger beetle facing the camera. The beetle has a metallic reddish-bronze head and thorax with iridescent blue-green highlights on the legs and body edges. It features large compound eyes, prominent white markings on the elytra, and long, slender legs positioned on a mossy green surface. The mandibles are visible but appear somewhat short in this frontal perspective.
